subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report intake + quick delegation kit
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report intake + quick delegation kit

Hi Samir —

Quick intro: I'm Jonas on the Redwood compliance team. Acme's procurement asked for our SOC 2 Type II report and guidance for handing off evidence; happy to help make this low-friction. Can you confirm the scope you need (entire platform vs. API-only) and whether your audit window needs the bridge letter?

What I can send immediately:
- The latest SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) — if you need it signed/bridged we can provide options
- A short intake checklist that lists minimal artifacts (policies, SSO configs, retention windows, sample logs)
- A one-line reply kit so your internal teams can delegate tasks to engineering/security owners

If you confirm scope + preferred transfer method (SFTP/presigned link/secure drive), I will: 1) attach the intake checklist, 2) include short reply templates for your teams, and 3) offer a presigned link option for the artifacts.

Thanks — aiming to keep this quick.

Jonas Weber
Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
Attachment: SOC2_TypeII_Intake_Checklist.pdf (stub)

From: Samir Patel <samir@acme.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report intake + quick delegation kit

Jonas — thanks for the fast reply. Scope: API-only (we only integrate via your hosted API). We will need a bridge letter that clarifies audit coverage through the requested period. Transfer: presigned link preferred. Also, can you include a minimal mapping to our SIG/CAIQ questionnaire where possible?

Samir Patel
Security Lead, Acme Corp
samir@acme.com
Procurement: procurements@acme.com

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II report intake + quick delegation kit

Samir — great, thanks for confirming scope. Per your ask I've attached a short intake checklist and two quick artifacts: a delegation reply pack and presigned-link instructions. Below are the concrete next steps and copy-paste replies your team can use.

Next steps (recommended):
1) I will generate a presigned S3 folder and email the link to procurements@acme.com (expires in 7 days).
2) We will include a draft bridge letter that states the coverage window and any exclusions for API-only usage. If you need it notarized, let me know — that takes additional sign-off.
3) For SIG/CAIQ, we can provide a mapping document; sample mappings are included in the Drive link.

Quick delegation templates (paste into your ticketing/email):
- To Engineering (logs/telemetry): "Can you pull a 7-day sample of API access logs (UTC) for the period 2025-07-01 to 2025-07-31 and upload to the presigned folder Samir will share? Contact: marissa.cole@redwood.com."
- To SSO Admin: "Please export the SAML metadata and recent latest sign-in events for user provisioning for the API integration. Upload to presigned folder."

Attachment stubs included: SOC2_TypeII_Intake_Checklist.pdf, delegation_quick_replies.txt, presigned-link-instructions.txt

If that's all good I'll send the presigned link by EOD and start a draft bridge letter you can review.

Best,
Jonas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>

Subject: Fwd: Request: SOC 2 Type II report intake + quick delegation kit

Ben / Olga — forwarding Acme's request. Ben: can you provision the presigned folder (7 day expiry, restricted to Acme procurement email) and include write-only permissions for uploads? Olga: can you own the bridge letter draft (API-only coverage + list of included controls) — I've attached the intake checklist.

- Engineering ownership: "Will gather the 7-day log slice and upload to the presigned folder by EOD +2. Please confirm when complete."
- Security ownership: "We'll provide the SIG mapping snapshot and a short control narrative for authentication/authorization within 3 business days."

Thanks — please confirm when done so I can reply to Samir.

Marissa Cole
